name: Antoine de Sagan
original_name: アントワーヌ・ド・サガン
source:
A ’39 survivor and ex-STX-SF commander and pilot. Sports honey-wheat hair and sapphire eyes. Prefers the more manly “Sagan” over “Antoine”… Originally from France.

[i]“I think I could have fun living in a place like this, even on my own.”[/i]

[From [url=https://shiravune.com/archives/3312]Shiravune[/url]]
